public_rationale: The arithmetic is correct: 750 × $10 million equals $7.5 billion, which is below $86 billion. This proposal is held unresolved solely because the required supported outcome needs a matching external outcome item, while the available source measures company valuation. There is no substantive uncertainty about the calculation. Its correctness does not establish that OpenAI itself was worth only $7.5 billion.
limitations: This is an evidence-format hold, not a finding that the arithmetic is doubtful.
The assumed headcount and per-engineer value are not validated as actual measurements.
